title: Affine-local properness of finite type relative Proj
statement: Let S be a scheme, E a quasi-coherent finite-type O_S-module, and U an affine open of S. The restriction to U of the structural morphism of the canonical relative Proj of Sym(E) is proper.

proof.text: Choose the affine finite-generator presentation of E over U. Its closed immersion into finite projective space makes the local relative Proj H-projective and therefore proper. The normalized symmetric-algebra pullback comparison identifies this local relative Proj map with the restriction of the global canonical relative Proj; transport properness across the induced arrow isomorphism.

lean.statement: theorem canonicalRelativeProj_restrict_proper {S : Scheme.{u}} (E : S.Modules) (hE : E.IsQuasiCoherentFiniteType) (U : S.Opens) (hU : IsAffineOpen U) : IsProper ((@SymmetricAlgebraSheaf.gradedAlgebraData S E hE.1).relProjHom ∣_ U)
